content.title: Walmart and OpenAI team up, Domino's & Albertsons earnings
content.description:
Here are just some of the stocks on the move on Tuesday, Oct. 14.

Walmart (WMT) is teaming up with OpenAI (OPAI.PVT) to create a ChatGPT shopping experience. Domino's Pizza (DPZ) reported Q3 results, sending shares higher. Shares of Albertsons (ACI) are surging after raising its full-year outlook.

To watch more expert insights and analysis on the latest market action, check out more Market Catalysts.

content.title: Albertsons Lifts Outlook as Price Cuts, Private-Label Push Boost Sales
content.summary: Albertsons  is absorbing higher costs to keep prices in check for budget-conscious shoppers.  “We see an increased usage in coupons,” Chief Executive  Susan Morris  said Tuesday on a call with analysts.  “We see them sticking closer to their shopping list, maybe not buying that extra item.”
